description: National Weather Service Precipitation Forecast is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri. This map displays the Quantitative Precipitation Forecast (QPF) for the next 72 hours across the contiguous United States, Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico. Data are updated hourly from the National Digital Forecast Database produced by the National Weather Service. The dataset includes incremental and cumulative precipitation data in 6-hour intervals. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri. Its keywords are Esri, NOAA, NDFD, NWS, NCEP, QPF, Precipitation, Forecast. The bounding box given is -180.0000,16.9683,-179.9981,66.8926. The hub shows 2026-08-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Esri Master License Agreement (terms of use of the source layer, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
